Name: Sir Robert's Perfect Pixel Plants
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[color=#ffffff][u][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/u][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=4]Sir Robert's Perfect Pixel Plants was a dream to create! Basically, I have the urge to re-pot any foilage or flower into a pretty vase or pot and I figure the best way to do this is by creating my own mods. This one features foilage from Stardew Valley that I re-configured with a lush green color palette and pretty pastel flowers in delicate glass vases! The possibilities are endless and you can re-imagine your home in Stardew Valley with an array of perfect pixel plants![/size][/color]

[u][color=#ffffff][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#ffffff][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods. The folder will contain images for the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. Once downloaded, the images can be found in the Decor/Houseplant section of the Furniture Catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[u][color=#ffffff][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#ffffff][size=4]Each image has a variety of Alternative Textures to choose from! The houseplants are limited to just a small number of colorful pots. However, the magic really begins with the flower section! There are approximately 50 flower images that I have separated into two groups: flowers in solid colorful vases and flowers in clear glass vases. I love the clear glass vases and hope you will enjoy them as well![/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4]Images #1 through #10 consists of flowers/houseplants that will fit on [u]end tables[/u]. There's a bunch to choose from via Alternative Textures.[/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4]Image #11 consists of flowers/houseplants via Alternative Textures that I have moved up a few pixels and they will align best on [u]countertops[/u]. I like to decorate both end tables and countertops, so this will give you plenty of options.[/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=4]Requires Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I also recommend using Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[u][color=#ffffff][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#ffffff][size=4]I've included a variety of end tables from the following mod creators to showcase my flowers and houseplants: Platinum Cats, Orangeblossom7, twinkle22, smallcopper, Creamy Cozy Decor by ENGloomy, Cozy Chocolate Furniture by skellady, Cozy Furniture by BackedPotatoes, and Cozy CottageCore Furniture by Riruru. The countertops are from PC's Shabby Chic Kitchen by Platinum Cats. [/size][/color]
